subject: Indian History
bookTitle: Our Pasts - I / Themes in Indian History Part 1
chapterName: In the Earliest Cities / Bricks, Beads and Bones
keyConcepts: Harappa, Mohenjo-daro, Great Bath, Citadel, drainage systems, Kalibangan, Lothal dockyard, seals, Harappan crafts and trade with Mesopotamia.
petSignificance: Repeated question in PET shifts regarding Lothal port, Great Bath discovery, and Harappan seals.

subject: Indian History
chapterName: What Books and Burials Tell Us
keyConcepts: Rigveda, Samaveda, Yajurveda, Atharvaveda, Sabha and Samiti, cattle wealth, rivers in Rigveda (Saraswati, Indus), Gayatri Mantra, Ashrama system.
petSignificance: Frequently tested for Vedic literature composition and Upanishads.

subject: Indian History
bookTitle: Our Pasts - I / Themes in Indian History Part 1
chapterName: New Questions and Ideas / Thinkers, Beliefs and Buildings
keyConcepts: Four Noble Truths, Eightfold Path (Ashtangika Marga), Buddha's First Sermon at Sarnath (UP), Mahavira's Triratna, Buddhist Councils (Rajgriha, Vaishali, Pataliputra, Kundalvana).
petSignificance: Crucial for PET: First sermon place (Sarnath), Mahaparinirvana (Kushinagar), both located in Uttar Pradesh.

subject: Indian History
bookTitle: Our Pasts - I / Themes in Indian History Part 1
chapterName: Ashoka, The Emperor Who Gave Up War / Kings, Farmers and Towns
keyConcepts: Chandragupta Maurya, Chanakya (Arthashastra), Megasthenes (Indica), Kalinga War (261 BCE), Ashoka's Dhamma, Rock Edicts, Sarnath Lion Capital (National Emblem).
petSignificance: Very high frequency. Sarnath pillar and Ashoka's inscriptions in UP (Topra, Meerut, Kaushambi) are tested.

subject: Indian History
chapterName: Traders, Kings and Pilgrims / New Empires and Kingdoms
keyConcepts: Samudragupta (Prayag Prashasti by Harishena), Chandragupta II Vikramaditya, Navratnas (Kalidasa, Aryabhata), Faxian, Harshavardhana (Kannauj assembly, Prayag Mahamoksha Parishad, Xuanzang's visit).
petSignificance: Kannauj & Prayag events under Harshavardhana are core UP history topics.

subject: Indian National Movement
keyConcepts: Meerut outbreak (10 May 1857), Mangal Pandey (Ballia/Barrackpore), Begum Hazrat Mahal (Lucknow), Nana Saheb and Tatya Tope (Kanpur), Rani Lakshmibai (Jhansi), Kunwar Singh, Maulvi Ahmadullah (Faizabad).
petSignificance: Guaranteed 1-2 questions because 1857 rebellion had its epicentre in Uttar Pradesh.

subject: Indian National Movement
bookTitle: Our Pasts - III / Themes in Indian History Part 3
chapterName: The Making of the National Movement: 1870s-1947 / Mahatma Gandhi and the Nationalist Movement
keyConcepts: Non-Cooperation Movement (Chauri Chaura incident in Gorakhpur, UP in 1922), Civil Disobedience & Salt Satyagraha (1930), Poona Pact, Quit India Movement (1942), Chittu Pandey's parallel government in Ballia (UP), Subhas Chandra Bose & INA.
petSignificance: Every PET shift asks about Chauri Chaura, Ballia parallel government, or Quit India resolution.

subject: Geography
topic: Rivers and Drainage System of India
topicHi: भारत की नदियां एवं अपवाह तंत्र
bookTitle: Contemporary India - I / India: Physical Environment
keyConcepts: Himalayan Rivers (Ganga, Yamuna, Brahmaputra, Indus) and Peninsular Rivers (Godavari, Krishna, Narmada, Tapi, Mahanadi, Kaveri). Left and right bank tributaries of Ganga in UP (Yamuna, Gomti, Ghaghara, Ramganga).
petSignificance: Direct mapping to PET topic 'Rivers and River Valleys'.

subject: Indian Constitution & Public Administration
topicHi: मौलिक अधिकार, नीति निदेशक तत्व एवं पंचायती राज
chapterName: Rights in the Indian Constitution / Local Governments
keyConcepts: Articles 12-35 (Fundamental Rights, Writs under Article 32 & 226), Articles 36-51 (DPSP), Article 51A (Fundamental Duties - 42nd Amendment), 73rd Amendment Act 1992 (11th Schedule, 29 subjects, Article 243).
petSignificance: Consistently accounts for 3 out of 5 Polity questions in UPSSSC PET.

subject: Indian Economy
topicHi: योजना आयोग, पंचवर्षीय योजनाएं एवं 1991 के सुधार
chapterName: Indian Economy (1950-1990) / Liberalisation, Privatisation and Globalisation
keyConcepts: Harrod-Domar model (1st FYP), PC Mahalanobis model (2nd FYP), Green Revolution (MS Swaminathan), Operation Flood (Dr. Verghese Kurien), 1991 LPG reforms under PV Narasimha Rao & Dr. Manmohan Singh, NITI Aayog (2015).
petSignificance: Exact word-for-word syllabus match in PET Section 4.
